chars.REDA: REDA: a 22-year-old Moroccan young man, short black curly hair, light stubble, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie with grease stains, black joggers and white sneakers
chars.FATHER: FATHER: a Moroccan mechanic in his late 50s, thick grey mustache, balding with grey hair on the sides, wearing dark blue mechanic overalls with a red rag hanging from the chest pocket
chars.SELLER: SELLER: a heavy-set Moroccan man in his 40s with a short black beard, wearing a brown leather jacket and a flat cap

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Inside a small cluttered car repair garage in Casablanca. REDA leans forward passionately, hands open, pitching a bold plan to FATHER, who stands with arms crossed and a doubtful frown next to an open car hood. Open tension between them, face to face, warm workshop light, tools on the walls.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Night in the same Casablanca garage. FATHER and REDA sit at a greasy workbench counting piles of Moroccan dirham banknotes under a single hanging bulb, FATHER pushing his whole savings forward, REDA excited, serious mood.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: FATHER alone in the doorway of the garage at dusk, rubbing his forehead with a worried expression, holding a thin stack of banknotes, the narrow Casablanca street behind him.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: In the garage, REDA grips FATHER's shoulder and looks him in the eyes, convincing him, FATHER hesitant and looking away. Emotional close two-shot, workshop background.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: A dusty used-car lot in Casablanca. REDA and FATHER stand in front of an old dented dark green Land Rover SUV from the 2000s with a broken headlight and scratched paint, REDA pointing at it eagerly, FATHER inspecting it with suspicion.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: At the used-car lot, FATHER hands a thick bundle of banknotes to SELLER, who smiles greedily, while REDA watches nervously beside the old green Land Rover. Tense moment of a big deal.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: The old green Land Rover parked inside the garage. REDA and FATHER stand at the open garage door looking out at a completely empty deserted Casablanca street at dusk, shops shuttered, ominous atmosphere, worried faces.
